Package org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.ops

Class GroomRuns

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.ops.GroomRuns
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class GroomRuns extends Object implements AutoCloseable
The groom-pet demo runs behind the Jobs page's terminal cards.

A run writes about 60 ANSI-styled lines to a MemoryTerminalSource, one step per tick: INFO and FINE lines (FINE is dim), a WARNING, check/cross marks, a progress strip of coloured blocks, a multi-line SEVERE entry, bold marker lines, and a canned ANSI transcript written as-is. Each tick also appends one ANSI line to a temp file, read through one FileTerminalSource per run. A verbose run first writes 8000 FINE lines.

Run ids are random 128-bit hex strings, so a terminal can be read only by someone who was given its id.

Example:

try (var runs = new GroomRuns(650)) { var run = runs.start("Rex", false, null); var source = runs.source(run.id()).orElseThrow(); }
